name: Git Status
author: santiagoei
description: Warns when any git repository under your watched folders has work pending to be synchronized: uncommitted changes, untracked files, or unpushed commits.

barWidget.description: Turns red when any watched git repository has uncommitted changes or unpushed commits. The popup lists them and lets you add or remove watched folders inline; click a repository to open lazygit there.

schema.label: Watched folders
schema.description: Comma-separated folders to scan for git repositories. ~ expands to your home directory; * and ? are a bulk add, storing every matching folder. Also editable from the panel itself.

schema.label: Search depth
schema.description: How many levels below each watched folder to look for .git directories.
